seo_title: Services: Brand strategy, identity and packaging — Sharp Story
seo_description: Brand strategy, brand identity and packaging design for D2C and FMCG brands. What each service includes, how long it takes and how we work.
label: Services
heading:
Three services.
One idea
running through them.
lead: Strategy finds the idea. Identity makes it visible. Packaging puts it in your buyer’s hand. Take one, or all three as one system.

services.title: Brand strategy
services.line: The thinking everything else stands on.
services.for: New brands deciding what they stand for, and growing brands that have lost the thread.
services.text: We research your category, your competitors and the people you sell to, then define the positioning, the story and the one idea your brand will own.

services.title: Brand identity
services.line: A brand people recognise before they read it.
services.for: Brands getting ready to launch, and brands whose look no longer matches where they’re going.
services.text: We turn the strategy into a complete visual and verbal system, built to work on a pack, a phone screen and a marketplace thumbnail.

services.title: Packaging design
services.line: Where the brand is picked up, opened and judged.
services.for: A first hero product, a new SKU, or a range that has grown faster than its packaging.
services.text: We design packaging as part of the brand system, so it stands out on shelf and on screen and extends cleanly across every variant.

together_note: Most new brands take all three as one project, so the strategy, identity and packaging are built together from the start.

process.title: Listen
process.text: We study the business, the category and the people you sell to through conversations, a competitor audit and research on shelf and on screen.
process.get: A research summary and a clear brief

process.title: Cut
process.text: We strip away what doesn’t matter until one idea is left, and agree it with you before any design starts.
process.get: Positioning and the one idea, in writing

process.title: Shape
process.text: We design the identity and packaging around that idea in two creative routes, then refine the chosen route over two rounds of feedback.

process.title: Launch
process.text: We prepare everything you need to go live and stay consistent, and work with your printer on proofs until the pack is right.
process.get: Guidelines, print-ready files and brand assets

call_text: Book a free 30-minute call. Share your brand when you book, and we’ll come with three honest observations on how it reads against your competitors.
